### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**4** anchor(s) derived from **2** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/report.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/report.md`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/report.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/report.md`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c48cd2c103a9dfa99313a67a3ec622291d793900` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `027da7046b0574c9174b9b1306ff6f3ef7f9544c` — the merge of head `061a780d00b130c4b5fcefd909c2f7f203ff4183` into base `c48cd2c103a9dfa99313a67a3ec622291d793900`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 027da7046b0574c9174b9b1306ff6f3ef7f9544c && git checkout 027da7046b0574c9174b9b1306ff6f3ef7f9544c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c48cd2c103a9dfa99313a67a3ec622291d793900 061a780d00b130c4b5fcefd909c2f7f203ff4183 && git checkout -B drift-repro c48cd2c103a9dfa99313a67a3ec622291d793900 && git merge --no-ff 061a780d00b130c4b5fcefd909c2f7f203ff4183

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c48cd2c103a9dfa99313a67a3ec622291d793900
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `061a780d00b130c4b5fcefd909c2f7f203ff4183`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts + packages/lint/src/validate-chart-bindings.ts (the gate that resolves the new key, read as one change with it), packages/spec/liveness/report.json (the row that grades it), and the cited code read on the head: packages/spec/src/ui/chart.zod.ts (`ChartConfigSchema` L601-760, `ChartSeriesSchema` L240-260, the `groupBy` notes), ui/packages/core/src/utils/chart-series.ts (`buildChartSeries` L567-690, the two-dimension pivot), ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx (`DatasetReportChart` L1178-1230, L1421), packages/spec/scripts/liveness/check-liveness.mts (`childrenDefault` L1105, `authorWarn` L1116-1140, `evidenceScope` L141), packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts L3306.

Inputs: card #27974 body and its two comments (claim 6526104358, os-dev-report 6527290895); PR #28191 body, 12-file list and the diff against `main` (merge base `9f13ee81`, +135/-8); the check-runs on `061a780d` (read 2026-10-30T16:43Z, last completion 2026-10-30T16:24:04Z): 50 names, all `completed`, 39 `success`, 11 `skipped`, 0 `failure`. Among the successes: Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Spec property liveness, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · CI/release/engine gates, the three scoped lints, Type Check · source/consumer/debt ledger, Test UI, Live E2E UI, Build Docs, Build UI Deps, Dogfood Regression Gate, Flag docs, Check Documentation Links; 11 `skipped` (opt-in harnesses, matrix placeholders, Lint UI, UI Published Artifacts, the schedule gate). Test Core 1/8-8/8, Build Core, Build & E2E UI, Type Check UI and Type Check · workspace completed `success` after the first reading. Author `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no login note is owed. The reviewer is not the drafter (`session_01L9qibxKEFRdVkHHwAWLUSE`).

### ① Derived judgments

1. `ReportChartSchema` (`report.zod.ts` L42-55) gains one optional key `seriesBy: z.string()`. `.extend()` keeps `ChartConfigSchema`'s `strictObject` and its error map, so the accept set widens by exactly this key on the report chart and nowhere else: the inline-data tier (`ChartConfigSchema` itself), dashboard `chartConfig` and `ChartSchema` nodes are untouched (verified: no `seriesBy` anywhere else under `packages/spec/src`). A list value is refused at path `seriesBy`; the absent key stays `undefined`. **Right.** Pinned by `report.test.ts` (accept / absent / list refused) and `chart.test.ts` L370-383 (the `.extend()` strictness pin now asserts the own key and still refuses `chartType` with the inherited rename).
2. The same schema serves `report.chart` and `blocks[].chart` (both tables in the regenerated `report.mdx` carry the row). No new acceptance there: `ReportSchema`'s joined refinement already refuses `chart` on a joined container and no renderer reads a block's `chart` (#20161), unchanged by this diff. **Right.**
3. `validateChartBindings` (`validate-chart-bindings.ts` L508, L584-594): `chart.seriesBy` on a chart-drawing report surface goes through `dimensionRef`, the same resolver as `xAxis`, so an undeclared name is a `chart-dimension-unknown` **error** at `reports[i].chart.seriesBy` with the did-you-mean hint, at `os validate`, `os build` and the report publish door. Joined containers and blocks (`drawsChart` false) stay silent, as for `xAxis`. **Right.** Pinned by the first new lint test (control + misspelling).
4. `validate-chart-bindings.ts` L596-599: with `seriesBy` set, `chart.series[].name` overrides are not passed to `measureRef`, so a `series[].name` naming a dimension value no longer raises `chart-measure-unknown`; without `seriesBy` the warning stands (control test). **Right, and consistent with the pivot it anticipates:** `buildChartSeries` with two dimensions and one measure derives one series per VALUE of `dims[1]` (`chart-series.ts` L592-600, `pivotSeriesBuckets`), so the measure name is no longer a series key. The `os explain chart-axis-not-selected` text (`rule-explanations.ts` L3306-3312) states the same rule. Noted, not a finding of this diff: the page-chart branch (L689-712) still judges `series[].name` against the measures when `properties.dimensions` has two entries, where the same pivot happens; a pre-existing asymmetry on another surface.
5. Liveness (`liveness/report.json`): the `chart` row now drills with `childrenDefault: live`, so every inherited `ChartConfig` key keeps the verdict the undrilled container row already gave it (same vouching as before); `aria` is graded `dead` with its retirement pointer (the tombstone is in the walked shape, `chart.zod.ts` L743 `retiredKey`); `seriesBy` is `planned`, `evidenceScope: in-repo`, `authorWarn: true` with an `authorHint`. `planned` + `authorWarn` is a legal pair (`check-liveness.mts` L1116-1140 throws only on a warned `live` row), and the author-side lint turns it into one `liveness-planned-property` finding on a report that writes the key, which the dev probed. The three nested containers the drill exposes (`series`, `annotations`, `interaction`) replace the single `report/chart` entry in `undrilled-containers.baseline.json`; `state-counts/report.md` regenerated (27 → 39 live, 1 dead, 1 planned). `Spec property liveness` is `success` on the head. **Right.**
6. Generated surfaces: `authorable-surface/ui.json` adds `ui/ReportChart:seriesBy`; `content/docs/references/ui/report.mdx` adds the row in both tables; `Check Changeset`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates` and `Build Docs` are `success`. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/27974-report-chart-series-by.md`: `@objectstack/spec` **minor** (one optional key on a published schema), `@objectstack/lint` **minor** (a new finding path on a new key, reachable from `os validate`/`os build`). Both match what the diff publishes; nothing is removed or tightened for existing input (a chart without `seriesBy` parses and lints exactly as before, incl. the `series[].name` warning). `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: added` sit line-initial on the PR body and the changeset. `Check Changeset` is `success`. **Consistent.**

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none declared.
- Deviation 1 (lint minor beside spec minor, the order named spec only): answered in ②, the lint diff publishes a finding, so the bump is owed.
- Deviation 2 (liveness edits beyond the order's file surface): answered in ①.5, without the drill the chart row's blanket `live` would vouch for a key nothing draws, and `check:liveness` would have had no row to warn the author from. Accepted.
- Deviation 3 (no assignee/reviewer written): FRAME forbids it; not a contract matter.
- `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` (`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`) and the `domain:ui` renderer half (`DatasetReportChart` queries `[xAxis]` × `[yAxis]`, L1210-1230, L1421): both are the seat's follow-up cards, as the PR body and the report say; the `planned` grade is what makes landing the contract half alone sound.
- `out_of_scope_findings` item 3 (stale `groupBy` sentence in the chart row's note): see S2 below.
- Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no login note.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts` against the card (#27974: a declared series dimension on `ReportChartSchema`, validated against the report's dataset, the ui half to follow) and its first consumer:

- **The key holds against the consumer it is written for.** `buildChartSeries(rows, [xAxis, seriesBy], [yAxis])` is exactly the two-dimension / one-measure branch (`chart-series.ts` L592): `dims[0]` is the x bucket, `dims[1]` the group pivoted into one series per value, label from the value, null/empty groups kept (objectui#4673). The docblock's `[xAxis, seriesBy]` × `[yAxis]` is a true description of that path, so the renderer card is a query-widening plus a pass-through, not a new pivot.
- **Own key, not the inherited `series`.** `ChartConfigSchema.series` is the per-series presentation override array (`chart.zod.ts` L691); one name with two meanings would have broken every reader of `series[]`. `groupBy` would collide with `aggregate.groupBy` on the react `ObjectChart` block, where it IS the category axis (`chart.zod.ts` L1007), and with the kanban lane field. Widening `xAxis` to a list would retype a key the Studio inspector and the renderer read as one string. The choice is the least-surprising of the four and the rejected shapes are named on the PR.
- **Dimension, not raw field.** The `.describe()` and docblock say bound-dataset dimension, matching `xAxis`, and the lint enforces it against the dataset's declared dimensions, so the spec and its gate agree.
- **Strictness rides.** Tested on the head (`chart.test.ts` L378): the own key is accepted and an undeclared one still gets the base error map's rename.
- **Nothing is retroactive.** Existing reports carry no `seriesBy`; their parse, lint and drawing are byte-identical.

Should-fix (none blocks the contract):
- **S1** `seriesBy` equal to `xAxis` parses and lints clean (the PR body says so). The pivot then makes every x bucket its own series: one bar per category with a legend entry each and no grouping, which is a silent misread of the author's intent. A `warning` in `validateChartBindings` when `seriesBy === xAxis` (same `path`) would cost one line; it can ride the renderer card.
- **S2** The `chart` row's `note` still reads "Sub-key `groupBy` stays experimental (its own describe marker) — the dataset renderer plots a single series and never reads it": `ReportChartSchema` has no `groupBy` and the row now drills, so the sentence is stale ledger prose (the dev noted it, left it). Replace or drop it when the row is next re-verified.
- **S3** The page-chart lint branch (L689-712) judges `series[].name` against the measures even when `properties.dimensions` has two entries, where the same pivot makes the series keys dimension values. Pre-existing; a follow-up card for the lint lane if an author trips over it.

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 报表图表新增可选键 `seriesBy`（数据集的第二个维度），把同一个度量按这个维度的每个取值拆成多组柱子。发布时拼错的维度名会被 `chart-dimension-unknown` 拦下。这次只落契约这一半，活性台账把它标成 `planned`，作者写了会收到“已声明、尚未生效”的提示。
- **为什么改：** 报表图表以前只能画一个 X 维度对一个 Y 度量。HotCRM 的“按负责人、再按阶段拆分”的漏斗只能退回成矩阵表。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加了一个可选键，不写它的报表解析、校验和绘制都不变。回滚即 revert。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts`（`ReportChartSchema.seriesBy`）、`packages/lint/src/validate-chart-bindings.ts`（与 `xAxis` 同一个解析器）、`packages/spec/liveness/report.json`。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-chart-bindings.test.ts -t seriesBy`，预期 2 条全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无。不属于受管面，契约复审已 PASS，由席位落地。渲染器那一半是 #28206，技能文档是 #28207。
- **席位意见：** ACCEPT，可落地。
